seo.description: Leila and Sam are getting married on Saturday 14 June at Hollin Barn. The day, how to get there, and where to RSVP.

props.title: Leila & Sam
props.text: are getting married at Hollin Barn, near Hebden Bridge, and would love you to be there.

items.title: Arrive
items.text: A drink in the orchard. Flat shoes, the grass is soft.

items.title: Ceremony
items.text: Under the big oak if it is dry, in the barn if it is Yorkshire.

items.title: Dinner
items.text: Long tables. Leila's mum is in charge of the rice.

items.title: Dancing
items.text: Sam's brother has a playlist and will not be stopped.

items.title: Carriages
items.text: Two minibuses back to Hebden Bridge.

items.label: By train
items.text:
Hebden Bridge station, then our
minibus at 1pm and 1.15pm

items.label: By car
items.text:
Hollin Barn, HX7 8PL
Parking in the lower field

items.label: Staying
items.text:
Rooms held at the White Lion
until 1 April: say our names

items.a: Yes, please do. There is a quiet room and a box of Lego.
Whatever you would wear to a nice dinner. Bring a jumper for the evening.
Truly, just come. If you insist, there is a honeymoon jar at the bar.

props.title: RSVP
props.text: Tell us who is coming and anything you cannot eat. By 1 May, please.
props.lMessage: Who is coming, and any food to avoid
